skill_name: What challenges do companies face when using ML systems?
workflow: Companies face a variety of challenges when using machine learning systems. One of the biggest challenges is ensuring that the models are accurate and reliable, particularly when dealing with large, complex datasets. Additionally, ML systems require significant upfront investment in development, training, and maintenance, as well as a technical staff to manage them.
